system.description: When you use the Force Shield Force Power, you can spend a Force Point to expand the radius of the Force Shield so that it protects you and all allies adjacent to you. Alternatively, you can spend a Destiny Point to have the Force Shield protect a Vehicle you occupy, regardless of the Vehicle's size. If the Vehicle already has a Shield Rating, the SR of the Vehicle and the SR granted by this Force Power do not stack.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
